# Grounded Studio

> Independent Android studio from the Netherlands building practical tools and games. Three products: BuildExact (construction calculator and quoting app for contractors), FreshGarant (food expiry tracker that reduces household food waste), and Circuit Trace (minimalist puzzle game).

Grounded Studio ships native Android apps focused on being fast, offline-capable and privacy-friendly. The website at grounded-studio.app serves as marketing site, documentation hub and blog. All calculator pages include real worked examples, formulas, and FAQ sections designed to answer common contractor questions directly.

## Products

- [BuildExact](https://grounded-studio.app/buildexact.html): Construction calculator and quote-to-invoice app for Dutch and Belgian contractors. 11 material calculators (fence, tiles, paint, plasterboard, insulation, roof, stairs, paving, timber, bricks, concrete), project management, PDF quotes with digital signature.
- [FreshGarant](https://grounded-studio.app/freshgarant.html): Food expiry tracker with AI fridge-scan, meal planning, price comparison and shopping lists. Helps households save on groceries and reduce food waste.
- [Circuit Trace](https://grounded-studio.app/games/circuit-trace.html): Minimalist Android puzzle game currently in beta. Trace circuits across hex grids with mechanics like warp portals and bridges.

## Calculators (BuildExact)

Each page explains the inputs, formula, a worked example with real numbers, FAQ, and screenshots of the app. All bilingual NL/EN.

- [All calculators overview](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators.html)
- [Fence calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/schutting.html): posts, panels, cut panel, gates, corners
- [Tile calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/tegels.html): tiles, boxes, adhesive, grout, cutting waste by pattern
- [Paint calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/verf.html): litres, coats, coverage, primer, tin sizes
- [Plasterboard calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/gipsplaat.html): boards, screws, joint filler, tape, single or double layer
- [Insulation calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/isolatie.html): R-value, packs, fasteners, multi-layer stacking
- [Roof calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/dak.html): pitch angle, surface, tiles, battens for various roof types
- [Stairs calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/trap.html): steps, riser, tread, stringers, Blondel comfort, Dutch building code
- [Paving calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/bestrating.html): stones, sub-base, laying sand, edge restraint, pattern
- [Timber calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/hout.html): volume, planks, beams, stain and varnish by exterior surface
- [Brick calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/bakstenen.html): bricks, mortar, lintels, wall ties, auto-subtracted openings
- [Concrete calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/beton.html): m³ ready-mix, rebar kg and bar count, optional formwork

## Blog

Long-form articles about construction cost, VAT rules, material estimation, food waste, meal planning and app features. Both NL and EN.

- [BuildExact blog hub](https://grounded-studio.app/blog/buildexact.html)
- [FreshGarant blog hub](https://grounded-studio.app/blog/freshgarant.html)
